content: Sai Kumar contacted insurance agent Ravi Menon to check the status of his home policy. Ravi confirmed that although the original policy (HC-2026-7854) expired on 15 August 2026, it was renewed on 20 August 2026 and is now active until 15 August 2027. Sai also requested to add a new garage to his coverage, and Ravi agreed to send an endorsement form via email shortly.

action_items: Send endorsement form via email to Sai Kumar for adding the new garage
